title: Download a model
description: Asks Ollama on the server to download a model. Runs in the background there, so it survives the phone disconnecting.

model.description: The model to download, for example qwen3:4b.

steps.title: Download the model
steps.why: Models are large; this runs in the background on the server.
steps.skipIf:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
curl -fsS -m 10 "http://$api/api/show" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" >/dev/null 2>&1
steps.run:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
echo "Downloading $P_model"
curl -sS -N "http://$api/api/pull" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" | awk '/"error"/ { print; err=1; next } { if (++n % 50 == 1 || /success/) print } END { exit err }'
steps.verify:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
curl -fsS -m 10 "http://$api/api/show" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" >/dev/null
